# 周末不无聊 No Boring Weekends

> 北美华人周末活动指南：15 个城市的亲子和大人周末活动，华人与亚裔社区活动优先，中英双语，每周更新（本期 11/20–11/22，更新于 2026-11-23）。
> Weekend events for families and grown-ups in 15 North American cities (festivals, shows, family outings, Chinese/Asian community events), bilingual, updated weekly.

每个城市有固定网址的「本周末」页面，内容每周替换；每个城市还有可订阅的日历（.ics）。活动信息以主办方官网为准。
Each city has a fixed weekend page that is replaced weekly, plus a subscribable .ics calendar. Check organizers' sites before going.

## 城市页（中文）
- [纽约本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nyc/): 10 个活动，MOCA 节日麻将之夜、MOCA 华埠历史徒步导览(12 月)、华美协进社:中国茶的艺术
- [新泽西本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/nj/): 8 个活动，Union 感恩节火鸡跑 5K 跑/走、Bayonne 感恩节火鸡跑(5K + 1 英里亲子跑)、South Amboy 海边感恩节 5K(可推婴儿车、带狗)
- [洛杉矶本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/la/): 3 个活动，Gentle Barn 动物农场「温柔的感恩节」、洛杉矶市政厅感恩节火鸡跑(有儿童跑、狗狗跑)、好莱坞圣诞大游行
- [旧金山湾区本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sf/): 3 个活动，旧金山植物园感恩节全天免费、金门公园感恩节火鸡跑(有儿童冲刺跑)、感恩节志愿者:给长者送餐探访
- [西雅图本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sea/): 2 个活动，绿湖感恩节 Apple Cup 5K、Magnuson 公园感恩节火鸡跑
- [波士顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/bos/): 7 个活动，华人文化中心:小书虫故事会、华人文化中心:工程与动手做(儿童)、华人文化中心:太极课
- [芝加哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/chi/): 4 个活动，林肯公园动物园 ZooLights 周一免费、加菲尔德公园温室冬季花展开幕、芝加哥感恩节大游行
- [休斯顿本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/hou/): 5 个活动，休斯顿儿童博物馆 Great Gobbler Fest、Discovery Green 舒缓瑜伽 + 颂钵(免费)、Buffalo Bayou 健康步行(免费)
- [达拉斯本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dal/): 5 个活动，Grapevine 圣诞点灯(免费)、迪士尼冰上世界(Allen,到 11/29)、达拉斯 YMCA 感恩节火鸡跑
- [华盛顿 DC本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/dc/): 8 个活动，国家美术馆雕塑花园溜冰场开幕、Safeway Feast of Sharing 感恩节志愿者、Hillwood 庄园节日展「编织仙境」
- [橙县 / 尔湾本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/oc/): 3 个活动，Tanaka 农场 Hikari 灯光节开幕、尔湾感恩节火鸡跑(有儿童跑)、Tustin 感恩节公益 5K(OC Rescue Mission)
- [圣地亚哥本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/sd/): 5 个活动，Helen Woodward 动物中心感恩节营(11/23–25)、巴尔博亚公园感恩节火鸡跑(Father Joe's)、科罗纳多感恩节 5K
- [亚特兰大本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/atl/): 2 个活动，Chamblee 中国城 Blooms 市集、亚特兰大感恩节半马 + 5K + 儿童跑
- [多伦多本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/tor/): 2 个活动，多伦多华人文化中心长者活动中心(周一至周五)、伊顿中心乐高节日工坊(到 11/29)
- [温哥华本周末活动](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/van/): 4 个活动，列治文图书馆中文幼儿时光、迪士尼冰上世界(PNE,11/25–29)、本拿比村博物馆节日村庄

## City pages (English)
- [New York weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nyc/): 10 events, e.g. Macy's Parade Balloon Inflation; 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade; National Museum of the American Indian open on Thanksgiving
- [New Jersey weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/nj/): 8 events, e.g. Union Township Turkey Trot 5K; Bayonne Turkey Trot; REPLENISH Thanksgiving Day Turkey Trot & 5K
- [Los Angeles weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/la/): 3 events, e.g. A Gentle Thanksgiving at The Gentle Barn; Turkey Trot LA; Hollywood Christmas Parade
- [SF Bay Area weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sf/): 3 events, e.g. SF Botanical Garden free on Thanksgiving; Golden Gate Park Turkey Trot; Volunteer on Thanksgiving: deliver meals to older adults
- [Seattle weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sea/): 2 events, e.g. Thanksgiving Day Apple Cup 5K; Magnuson Turkey Trot
- [Boston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/bos/): 7 events, e.g. Busy Bookworms at Chinese Culture Connection; Engineering & Tinkering at Chinese Culture Connection; Friendsgiving at Trident Booksellers & Cafe
- [Chicago weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/chi/): 4 events, e.g. Lincoln Park ZooLights free Monday; Garfield Park Conservatory Winter Flower Show; Chicago Thanksgiving Parade
- [Houston weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/hou/): 5 events, e.g. Great Gobbler Fest at the Children's Museum of Houston; Gentle Yoga & Sound Bowl Healing at Discovery Green; Buffalo Bayou Wellness Walk
- [Dallas weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dal/): 5 events, e.g. Grapevine Carol of Lights; Disney On Ice, Allen; Dallas YMCA Turkey Trot
- [Washington DC weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/dc/): 8 events, e.g. National Gallery of Art Sculpture Garden ice rink opens; Volunteer at Safeway's Feast of Sharing; A Woven Wonderland at Hillwood
- [Orange County weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/oc/): 3 events, e.g. Irvine / OC Turkey Trot; Turkey Trot OC 5K at the Orange County Rescue Mission; Tanaka Farms Hikari Festival of Lights
- [San Diego weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/sd/): 5 events, e.g. Thanksgiving camp at Helen Woodward Animal Center; Father Joe's Turkey Trot at Balboa Park; Coronado Turkey Trot 5K
- [Atlanta weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/atl/): 2 events, e.g. Atlanta Thanksgiving Day Half Marathon, 5K, Mile & Dash; Blooms Chinatown Market
- [Toronto weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/tor/): 2 events, e.g. Active Living Centre for Chinese Seniors at CCCGT; LEGO Holiday Workshop at CF Toronto Eaton Centre
- [Vancouver weekend events](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/en/van/): 4 events, e.g. Toddler Time for Chinese Speaking Families (Mandarin, Cantonese & English); Disney On Ice at the Pacific Coliseum; Festive Village at Burnaby Village Museum

## Data
- [events.json](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/events.json): all events with dates, times, venues, prices and official links
- [seasonal.json](https://noboringweekends.pages.dev/seasonal.json): long-running seasonal attractions (lights, markets, rinks, shows) with date ranges and hours
